{{Top}} The '''Cave of Shadows''' was a fictional location that appeared in a story that [[Wim]] read on his [[storypad]]. The tale was written in [[Aurebesh]] and went as follows:{{SkeletonCrew|This Could Be a Real Adventure}} [[File:Lina Storypad 1 - This Could Be a Real Adventure.jpg|thumb|250px|right|[[Lina (Jedi)|Lina]] in the Cave of Shadows]] {{ExcerptIU|THE CAVE OF
SHADOWS WAS DARK
AND OMINOUS, BUT
LINA WAS NOT
AFRAID. SHE IGNITED HER
LIGHTSABER, IT'S ''[sic]''
BLUE GLOW LIGHTING
UP THE DARKNESS.
READY FOR WHAT
LAY AHEAD. SUDDENLY, THE SITH APPEARED BEFORE
HER, IN DARK ROBES]] AND A RED LIGHT SABER ''[sic]''.
"YOU SHOULD NOT HAVE COME HERE," HE HISSED,
HIS VOICE ECHOED THROUGH THE CAVE}} [[File:Lina Storypad 2 - This Could Be a Real Adventure.jpg|thumb|250px|right|[[Lina (Jedi)|Lina]] dueling a [[Sith]] in the Cave of Shadows]] ==Appearances== *{{SkeletonCrew|This Could Be a Real Adventure}} {{1st}} {{C|Appears on [[storypad]]}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Grotte des ténèbres |ja=影の洞窟 |ka=ჩრდილების გამოქვაბული (გამოგონილი) }} [[Category:Fictional locations]]
